notes.title: SMALL UPDATE / PATCH NOTE 01
notes.notes:
Hello dear island residents, 

We fixed the prestige tree bug in this minor update.

notes.title: MEER'S ESCAPE : VERSION 1.0.1.2 UPDATE
notes.notes:
[b]Hello dear island residents,[/b]

[i][b]Today we bring you an update. In version 1.0.1.2 we changed some objects, removed some objects, fixed some bugs and more.[/b][/i]

[h2][b]FIXED[/b][/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed island decomposition bug.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Fixed the bug where workers did not do the given job.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Fixed bugs where workers could get stuck in buildings.
[/list]

[h2][b]ADDED[/b][/h2]

[list]
[*] New prestige tree added.
[/list]
[list]
[*] New poor house added.
[/list]

[h2][b]CHANGED[/b][/h2]

[list]
[*] ESCAPE modified to escape from the island.
[/list]
[list]
[*] The chests have been changed.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Shops have been changed.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Food packages have been changed.
[/list]
[list]
[*] The shrubs have been changed.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Mushrooms have been changed.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Houses have been changed.
[/list]

[h2][b]REMOVED[/b][/h2]

[list]
[*] All logs removed.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Box removed.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Camp House removed.
[/list]
[list]
[*] House C, House D and House E removed.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Patron's House removed.
[/list]
[list]
[*] All bonfires removed.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Well A, Well B and Well C removed.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Food Pack B and Food Pack C removed.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Mushroom B removed.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Tin Mine removed.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Mystery Chest removed.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Spare Chest removed.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Shop B and Shop C removed.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Ancient Tower removed.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Watch Tower removed.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Church removed.
[/list]

Have a nice day,

Emre YILDIZ
